item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya rubs a plastic comb on her dry hair and holds it near tiny pieces of paper on her study table. The paper pieces jump up and stick to the comb.
Her brother Aarav then rubs a second comb in the same way and brings the two charged combs near each other.
Which statement about these observations is correct?

options.A: The paper sticks because the comb acquires the same type of charge as the paper.
options.B: The two charged combs repel each other because they carry similar charges.
options.C: The two charged combs attract each other because they carry opposite charges.
options.D: The paper sticks to the comb because of the magnetic force of the comb.
